about_the_game:
Welcome to Tavernia fantasy tavern where every night is a constant tug-of-war between order and chaos. As the tavern keeper, your job sounds simple: serve drinks, chat with customers, and keep the tables from flipping. In practice, your tavern attracts rowdy knights, reckless rogues, drunken orcs, and creatures who have never heard of “last call.”

Tavernia is a single-player comedy simulator that blends management with mayhem. Each shift is unpredictable: you’ll pour drinks under pressure, defuse brawls before they spread, fix magical mishaps, and keep the place from collapsing into a very expensive campfire. Quick decisions, smart upgrades, and a steady hand behind the bar make the difference between a profitable night and a legendary disaster.

Key Features

Grow your tavern through clear progression and meaningful investments. Upgrade tiers (T1 → T2 → T3) change how your night plays out more capacity, smoother flow, and new ways to operate.

Brawl System

Not every customer comes for a quiet drink. When tempers rise, a brawl can erupt fast. Stop it early or manage the chaos when it spills across the room.


Build a menu that fits your crowd. Expand your selection over time and serve the right drink to keep guests happy—and profits rising.

Special NPC Visitors 
Not every guest comes for a quiet drink. From time to time, unique NPCs will step into Tavernia with requests only you can handle—bringing new objectives, unexpected twists, and rewards if you can deliver.

Serving Drinks

Keep the bar running smoothly by pouring, serving, and staying one step ahead of the rush. The right drink at the right time keeps guests happy and keeps the night under control.

Pour, manage, survive and most importantly… have fun while everything falls apart around you.

content_descriptors.notes:
Alcohol Fermentation, Selling & Consumption, Goofy Cartoon Violence, Mature Language, Profanity, Themes of Racism among Fantasy Races, Fighting & Stealing 
Game is about running a bar, so all the events, cursing profanity etc.. are random encounters chosen from a pool with various triggers. 

Races are Fantasy races like Human, goblin, dwarvef, elves, orcs vampires etc..

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
